_note: Output of the real code on ILLUSTRATIVE fictional inputs.

offer.name: ExampleDispatch Pro
offer.target_customer: owner-operators of HVAC and plumbing companies with 3-15 technicians
offer.problem: Scheduling technicians by phone and spreadsheet takes hours every week and causes double-bookings
offer.desired_outcome: Schedule a full week of jobs in under 30 minutes with no double-bookings
offer.value_proposition: See and schedule every technician's week on one screen, with automatic text reminders
offer.differentiation: Unlike spreadsheets, technicians see jobs on their phones and customers get reminders automatically

summary.title: ExampleDispatch
h1: The innovative all-in-one field service platform

recommendations.recommendation: Repeat the ad's promise/offer in the H1 or subheadline.
recommendations.hypothesis: Visitors who don't see what they clicked for bounce.
evidence: The innovative all-in-one field service platform

recommendations.finding: No CTA in the hero section
recommendations.recommendation: Place the primary CTA in the hero (above the first section break).
recommendations.hypothesis: Visitors ready to act shouldn't need to scroll.

recommendations.finding: No social proof or evidence on the page
recommendations.recommendation: Add verified proof: real reviews with source, customer logos (with permission), data, demo video.
recommendations.hypothesis: Proof reduces perceived risk, especially for new brands.
Without it, mobile browsers render a zoomed-out desktop page.

recommendations.recommendation: State the specific outcome for the reader (in their words).
evidence: The innovative all-in-one field service platform

recommendations.recommendation: Use action + value text, e.g. 'Get my free quote', 'Start 14-day trial'.
recommendations.hypothesis: Specific CTA text clarifies what happens next.

recommendations.finding: Offer price not shown on page
recommendations.recommendation: State price (or 'from') and what's included, or explain why pricing is on request.
recommendations.hypothesis: Hidden pricing raises uncertainty for price-sensitive buyers.

recommendations.finding: Deliverables not mentioned: ['drag-and-drop schedule', 'technician mobile app', 'SMS reminders', 'customer list import']

recommendations.recommendation: Ask only what's needed now; move the rest to after signup (progressive profiling).
recommendations.hypothesis: Each extra field adds effort and drop-off risk.

recommendations.recommendation: Add a meta description that mirrors the headline promise.
recommendations.hypothesis: Improves search snippet relevance and CTR.

recommendations.recommendation: Add a short privacy note under the form.

recommendations.finding: Hero copy doesn't address the reader
recommendations.recommendation: Rewrite hero around the reader's outcome ('you').

limitations: Static analysis only: no rendering, speed or real-user data.
output.note: Each recommendation is a hypothesis; validate with tests or user research.
